A '''male''' who was the brother of [[Five World Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Denjax Teppler]] served the [[Corellian Security Force]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. He [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] four [[YVH-Series battle droid]]s to be loyal to Teppler during tensions between [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and later served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Aidel Saxan]] when she met with Galactic Alliance representatives on [[Toryaz Station]]. Both he and Saxan were [[Attack on Toryaz Station|killed]] there.
